Class ShapeClipperDrawing2D

Provides immediate-style drawing helpers for polygons and polylines backed by ShapeClipper triangulation.

public static class ShapeClipperDrawing2D

Remarks

These helpers generate temporary triangulated meshes through ShapeClipperTriangulation2D and draw them immediately using a shared reusable TriMesh buffer. The class is intended for sequential use and is not thread-safe.

DrawPolygonOutlineGlow(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, ValueRange, ValueRangeColor, int, float, bool, bool)

Draws a glowing polygon outline by rendering multiple outline passes with thickness and color interpolated across the supplied ranges.

public static void DrawPolygonOutlineGlow(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonCCW, ValueRange thicknessRange, ValueRangeColor colorRange, int steps, float miterLimit = 2, bool beveled = false, bool useDelaunay = false)

Parameters

polygonCCW IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The polygon vertices, expected in counterclockwise order.

thicknessRange ValueRange

The outline thickness range used from the first pass to the final pass.

colorRange ValueRangeColor

The color range used from the first pass to the final pass.

steps int

The number of glow passes to render. A value of 1 draws a single pass using the maximum thickness and color.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for sharp joins.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should use beveled corners.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

Remarks

The first pass is triangulated at Min and subsequent passes scale the generated mesh about its centroid while interpolating colors.

DrawPolygonOutlineTriangulationMasked(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, float, ColorRgba, float, bool, bool)

Draws the outline of a polygon after subtracting a mask polygon from it, triangulating the remaining outline area and rendering the generated mesh.

public static void DrawPolygonOutlineTriangulationMasked(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonCCW, IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonMask, float thickness, ColorRgba color, float miterLimit = 2, bool beveled = false, bool useDelaunay = false)

Parameters

polygonCCW IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The source polygon vertices, expected in counterclockwise order.

polygonMask IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The polygon vertices to subtract from the source polygon.

thickness float

The outline thickness in world units.

color ColorRgba

The color used to draw the generated mesh.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for sharp joins.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should use beveled corners.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

Remarks

This overload subtracts polygonMask from polygonCCW, discards holes in the clipped result, triangulates the resulting outline through ShapeClipperTriangulation2D, and draws the shared temporary mesh buffer.

DrawPolygonTriangulationMasked(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, ColorRgba, bool)
